cardOverview.overviewText: An invite-only White Reserve card delivering ultra-premium lifestyle privileges, luxury travel perks, concierge support, and milestone bonuses.

benefitRows.name: Club Marriott
benefitRows.offer: With complimentary concierge services, enjoy luxurious experiences like a personal shopping team, access to exclusive events around the world, dining reservations at the finest restaurants across the world, and much more.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Club Marriott membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Download the Club Marriott app, open it, and tap “Activate Membership.” Enter your membership number or registered mobile number, set a 6-digit PIN, and complete activation. Once activated, enjoy exclusive benefits at participating Marriott hotels.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy 2 golf rounds every month at selected golf courses around the world.
